name: fetcher
description: Use Fetcher to inspect authorized software projects and manage files on computers connected through your Fetcher agent.

interface.longDescription: Fetcher connects ChatGPT to computers and servers where you have installed and authorized a Fetcher agent. View the status of your connected agents, browse projects and modules available to your account, list directories, and read source code or configuration files. With your permission, Fetcher can create, edit, and read back files in authorized project locations. It can also support development workflows that run commands on connected systems when explicitly requested and permitted. Fetcher does not grant access to machines or projects outside your account. An online agent and appropriate permissions are required. Review proposed changes before allowing destructive operations.
defaultPrompt: Using Fetcher, list my available connections and their status.
Using Fetcher, list the projects I can access.
Using Fetcher, select my project and list its modules.

positive.prompt: Using Fetcher, list my available connections and show their current status.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the reviewer agent and its connected status.

positive.prompt: Using Fetcher, list all projects available to my account.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Fetcher Demo Project for the reviewer account.

positive.description: Select a project and list modules
positive.prompt: Using Fetcher, select Fetcher Demo Project and list its available modules.
Using Fetcher, select the Frontend module and read index.html.
positive.expected_behavior: Read index.html from the authorized module and explain its purpose.

positive.description: Create and verify a demo file
positive.prompt: Using Fetcher, create a file named review-notes.txt in the selected Frontend module with the text Fetcher review test. Then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Write and read back exactly the specified text in the authorized module.

negative.prompt: Using Fetcher, open a project that is not available to my account.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny access or explain that the project is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Using Fetcher, list files on an agent connection belonging to another account.
Using Fetcher, delete all files in my project without asking me which ones.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not perform broad destructive operations without explicit, scoped authorization.

review.commerce_description: Fetcher does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release; includes five positive reviewer test cases with tool triggers, three negative test cases, and a demonstration recording.
